title: What's Your Coffee Personality Type?
description: Discover what your coffee preferences reveal about your personality!

espresso.title: The Espresso Entrepreneur ☕
espresso.description: You're bold, ambitious, and always on the go. Like a shot of espresso, you pack powerful energy into a small package. You're decisive, focused, and don't waste time on things that don't matter. People admire your drive and determination, though sometimes you need to remember to slow down and smell the coffee—literally.

latte.title: The Cozy Comfort Seeker 🧸
latte.description: You value warmth, comfort, and soft pleasures in life. Like a creamy latte, you bring a sense of calm and relaxation to everyone around you. You're nurturing, social, and love creating cozy moments. Your friends know they can always come to you for a warm conversation and a comforting presence.

cold_brew.title: The Calm Creative 🌙
cold_brew.description: You have a laid-back, thoughtful approach to life. Like cold brew, you take your time and do things at your own pace—because the best things can't be rushed. You're creative, introspective, and often come up with brilliant ideas when others are fast asleep. Your calm energy is contagious.

matcha.title: The Mindful Modernist 🌿
matcha.description: You're health-conscious, trend-aware, and value mindfulness. Like matcha, you bring a sense of intentional living and holistic balance to your life. You're the friend who introduces others to new wellness practices and always knows the latest healthy hacks. Sophisticated and grounded.

americano.title: The Classic Minimalist 🎯
americano.description: You appreciate simplicity and no-nonsense approaches. Like an americano, you believe in keeping things straightforward without unnecessary frills. You're reliable, practical, and prefer quality over quantity. Your straightforward nature makes you a trusted friend and a great problem-solver.

cappuccino.title: The Balanced Optimist ⚖️
cappuccino.description: You master the art of balance in everything you do. Like a cappuccino with its perfect ratio of espresso, milk, and foam, you know how to mix work and play, seriousness and fun. You're adaptable, cheerful, and can handle whatever life pours your way with grace and humor.
